advice_not_proof: Agreement is advice, never proof; here even the advice splits 2-1 at low confidence. The decision rests on the evidence below, with Jev as a check on my framing, not a vote to follow blindly.
dissent_analysis: R1 (independence framing) chose split 0.65/conf 0.47; R2 (lineage/QD1-needs framing) and R3 (normative-scope framing) chose full 0.58/0.58, conf 0.38/0.37. external_n_dispatch rejected in all three (<=0.02). The split reflects genuine tension, not undersold prose: R1's framing centered the candidate-minting-its-own-facts risk, R2/R3 centered the I13 card's complete-API-surface mandate and the I03/I04 doubles precedent. R1's concern is real but mis-targeted: K22's normative independence binds observer-vs-ADAPTER (C code under test), and no merge shape lets C touch the TS service; the candidate is the test author, not the adapter. The I02 witness analogy fails on authority: the K05 witness VERIFIES co-minted triples (candidate reach would mint credit), while this observer only HOLDS and COMPARES facts with creditVerdict hardwired creditC:false and all credit held by host-run QD1 under suite-snapshot review. A candidate that records fabricated rows and compares them mints nothing. Conversely the I13 card explicitly requires signatures, effects, opaque handles, errors and mandatory assertions with no deferral to the Q case; the split would strand namespace/connection lifecycle host-side and reduce the Can example to hand-built-record comparison, deferring the handle/effect surface to QD1. Mitigation for R1 (I02-decision pattern: keep every independence-preserving element that does not cost the mandate): owner-first ops, NT-I13 tag + scope elision, inert fact records, documented QD1 recording discipline (host records C behavior in qualified runs), suite-snapshot review of record call sites, provisional status until P14.
implementation_shape: Port core.ts + returning.ts verbatim to runtime/test-support/slices/i13/; adapter owns one DbObserverService + one ReturningObserver; 20 owner-first db:: catalogue operations under NT-I13 with owner elision; wrong-owner/closed-handle/forged-token/unknown-connection map to test::stale_handle, other DbObserverCode rejections to db::db_fault{layer,code} naming engine/driver/sql; Can package with closed vocabularies (layers, cell tags) + per-op wrappers + typed seed/read/compare roundtrip example; QD1 recording discipline documented; provisional until P14.
